attorneys: Max Weber, prose. Solicitor General Fahy for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied on the ground that the cause is moot, it appearing that petitioner has been released upon order of the United States Board of Parole and that he is no longer in the respondent’s custody. The motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis is therefore also denied.
